segments.text: Hi, my name is Lame Charter. I am head coach from the United Kingdom with 11 years of experience in coaching and youth in amateur football.
This is job interview for The Job Soccer.
Two things first, a serious knee injury at 19 ended my playing career and it taught me to game through other people's development.
Second, six years coaching a youth academy under mentor who made my every session with clear purpose.
My mission to make players better and better footballers in safe, demanding environment.
If a player leaves me more confident, more intelligent, tactically with good habits than I have done in my life, winning followers from that is not the starting point.
I agree objectives that club at the start of the season, results player progression, how many players move up levels, then how I review every month.
I also look at attendance, injury and the player's feedback because of health squad is a sign at the work right.
I look at the plan against match data, chances created, short concern, recovering the opposition half and how we will keep our shape.
I also use video to separate two problems, the plan is wrong or the player executed badly. This makes difficult from a pitch.

I give every player one clear match task, then I check it clips from the game. For example, if he trains a pressing together, I could how open it appears on Saturday and if it doesn't show up, I back training and make it more game like.
Second and specific, I never show more than 10 minutes, I pick three clips, one press, two to improve, then I ask player what they saw about before I explain again.
People learn more from their discovery than my lecture.
What principle guide you style of play, how do you reinforce that they control the ball, press together and take behavior decisions.
I reinforce them with my simple words and the player use themselves. I repeat them in every warm up and I face the behavior, not only the result, a principle only lives in the field daily.
I simply before I repeat, I reduce the numbers, slow it down and shows how a small ball or video.
Last season, my defense struggled with a back four line and I worked small group and three week the line stays in fact in match.
I finish my club out of the best player race with new phrasing rules and start arriving late, I meet privately, I explain them the reason and standard applies for everyone.
I waited right after the match, I say very little and thanks and support, only thanks and support.
The real conversation happens next day when everyone is claimed, then we look at what we control and what we learn and what we change on Tuesday.
Emotions first, analytics second.

We were 1-0 down against a team that blocked at the middle and half of our team, half team I saw keep freezing the traffic, I moved on the midfielder wide, asked the full backs to overlap and change the target to far side.
We scored twice in the second half and won 2-1.

I go back basic routines, same preparation, same behavior, small targets, like winning the first 20 minutes, I also protect the players confidence by showing them what they are doing well. Standards are held by the habits, not speeches.
Also check each player, learn some, need to see them, I also see the videos of demonstration, I also need to feel it could be like them, a small game, some needs towards, and time.
Honestly and respect, I tell players to do even when they are not want to hear, I respect everyone in the club and keep men to the captain.
In my second season I lost 5 games in a row, I changed my system to open, I confused the players, now I stuck to the proper plan and find out the issues in that plan.
